verified: Training top5 truth uses only Apr13-May18 outcome labels; historical feature arrays remain cutoff-specific. Evaluation labels are not passed to fitting.
Airing query groups user/event before programme counts, using max clipped single-fragment overlap and strict >80percent full airing duration.
Top5 truth is selected across all qualifying programmes before intersecting retrieved candidates; descending qualified-airing count ties break by numeric item ID.
ytop<=fit.y explicitly verifies top5 fitting labels are a subset of broad strict labels.
Boolean keep removes complete original groups and preserves row order; group sizes sum to retained rows, so LightGBM query contiguity is correct.
Broad evaluation uses full truth_counts, not only retrieved positives; each proxy uses its full saved truth through apk. Empty users remain AP0; cold fallback is unchanged.
Protocol correctly distinguishes NDCG-weighted LambdaRank from exact MAP optimization and leaves hidden target construction unconfirmed.
caveats: The two label variants can retain different user groups because no-positive groups are removed separately; differences therefore include label choice and retained fitting population, not a perfectly isolated label-only effect.
Both evaluation windows and multiple target proxies have already been explored; selecting the best observed metric does not verify the official target.
Feature schema equality and full input hashes would strengthen reproducibility, although current source alignment was reviewed previously.
